keyFinding: The mean annual R in Greece is 1039 MJ·mm/ha/h/y, with a range between 405.1 and 3160.2 MJ·mm/ha/h/y.

filename: wang2016.pdf
methodology: The authors analyzed the performance of a modified Richardson model that incorporated seasonal variations in parameters α and β.
keyFinding: The newly modified model is highly recommended when monthly rainfall erosivity is required.

filename: water-15-02408.pdf
methodology: Correlation analysis was applied to study the impact of global extreme climate events on the ACI.
keyFinding: The asymmetric characteristic of extreme rainfall erosion was analyzed and expressed by an asymmetric change index (ACI) defined in this study.

filename: wei2009.pdf
methodology: The authors analyzed 158 natural rainfall events from 1986 to 2005, using rain depth and maximal 30-min intensity (MI30) to define rainfall extremes (RE).
keyFinding: The authors found that rainfall extremes (RE) caused severer soil-water loss, and that vegetation types had different buffering capacities against RE.

filename: xie2016.pdf
methodology: The authors developed three models to estimate daily rainfall erosivity in China using one-minute resolution rainfall data from 16 stations. The models were parameterized using 5942 erosive events from 10 stations and validated using 4949 erosive events from 6 stations.
keyFinding: The authors developed three models to estimate daily rainfall erosivity in China using one-minute resolution rainfall data from 16 stations.

filename: zhu2019.pdf
methodology: The revised universal soil loss equation and the NSW/ACT Regional Climate Modeling (NARCliM) projections were used to estimate rainfall erosivity and hillslope erosion.
keyFinding: Rainfall erosivity and hillslope erosion are projected to increase in the Australian Alpine region.
